subject.title: refactor: use semver package for version ordering

question: Should this broad comparator replacement land after the exact pinned Codex user-agent contract and refreshed dependency/security checks are verified, accepting strict rejection of unsupported malformed versions?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent, but version ordering controls upgrades, plugin selection, and protocol gates, so accepting the stricter compatibility boundary is an owner-level merge decision.
